events.title: The MMM Demo Is Now Available!
events.summary: Hi everyone, I'm the solo developer at DH_GameStudio, working on Money Makes Money: Historical Market Simulator. After about seven months of development, I've released a free demo on Steam!The demo offers a limited part of the full game. If you give it a try, I'd like to hear which explanations felt unclear and which moments made you think about your next move. For bugs or other feedback, please use the Steam discussions. events.title: Our First Game Review Is Here!
events.summary: Hello everyone! Our first (self-)review is now live on YouTube!A lot has been added and refined recently, and I’m now polishing the game for the upcoming demo. This video is a chance to see how it’s shaping up before you get to try it yourself. The demo is planned to arrive ahead of October’s Steam Next Fest, with the full game planned for November.
